operation.source_intent: Search the authoritative application-user list by the bound username term and render the matching result set.

source_semantics.normalization: trim then case-insensitive normalized username contains
source_semantics.busy_guard: _working disables the Search action while LoadAsync is active
source_semantics.failure: LoadAsync surfaces the exception instead of claiming refreshed data

laravel_runtime.authoritative_reread: React Query fetches the active tenant endpoint with the trimmed term even when the applied term is unchanged
laravel_runtime.literal_search: percent, underscore, and the escape character are escaped before SQL LIKE so user input preserves Contains semantics

state_and_security.control_permission: members.manage or wildcard, preserving the source UsersManage page boundary
state_and_security.read_permission: tenant.view on the established members read endpoint
state_and_security.tenant_resolution: auth + tenant.context; a foreign tenant slug returns 404
state_and_security.tenant_identifier_source: context.api['application-users']; the control owns no tenant or membership identifier

coverage: authorized submit control and Arabic copy
foreign tenant search fails closed with 404
